summary: Destroys a targeted weapon within 20'; only the weapon, not its wielder, needs to be in range and visible.

requirements.note: The weapon, not the person, is the target.

references.name: range
references.note: Only the equipment must be within range and visible.

clarifications.text: The equipment, not the person carrying it, is the target of Shatter Weapon.
Only the weapon has to be within range and visible for Shatter Weapon to affect it; the wielder need not be.

open_questions: The text does not say whether protections on the wielder (Immunities, Enchantments) protect the targeted weapon; since the weapon, not the person, is the target, the plainer reading is that the wielder's personal protections do not apply.
